callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a valid directory path.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized with the CodeGraph index at proj_dir, or None if the index is unavailable or cannot be opened.

callees.name: get_functions_by_file
callees.pre_condition: lang_key is a language key string recognized by the CodeGraph index. proj_dir is the project directory path used to anchor relative paths.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each absolute file path to a dict of {function_identifier: function_source_text} for all indexed functions in files matching the given language key under proj_dir.

callees.name: _normalized_relative_path
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory path. abs_path is an absolute file path that lies within or under proj_dir.
callees.post_condition: Returns the path of abs_path relative to proj_dir, using forward slashes as separators and containing no leading slash or dot segment.
